verdicts.decision_note: The client identifies the checkout UI requirement to let customers select among enabled payment assets.
First concrete failure: checkout provided no ETH/USDC selection despite both assets being available in the wallet.
The adjacent freelancer answers conflict about whether checkout supports only USDC or both ETH and USDC, materially affecting the required selection behavior.

The client defines concrete checkout UI rules for displaying a sole settlement currency and requiring selection when both currencies are available; the replaced general selection key exists in prior state.
The client's conditional rules resolve the preceding value ambiguity and return the requirement to active status.
The client unambiguously accepts the adjacent proposal to expose ETH alongside USDC through a customer-facing selection control.
The client requires the checkout UI to keep the Card option unavailable until that payment method is implemented.
Distinct later failure: checkout enabled the unimplemented Card option while disabling the supported ETH option.
